summary: Ran authenticated API regression checks and mobile web smoke test. Admin login, invite creation, and component-level API passed; seeded player login failed with 404. Public preview rendered Invalid Host header, so UI flows could not be exercised.

critical.issue: Required credentials TestUser1/password123 return HTTP 404 (user is not present or login route masks missing user). This blocks buildings, research, shipyard and spaceport verification.

integration_issues.issue: https://code-review-tool-44.preview.emergentagent.com/ displays 'Invalid Host header'; no login or game UI is reachable.

action_items: Seed or restore TestUser1 with password123, or provide a valid test account, then rerun all authenticated flows.
Fix preview host configuration so the configured public URL is accepted by the frontend dev server; rerun mobile UI tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth initialization code is present for registration/login fallback, but it cannot be validated until a usable player account exists.
Ship calculator frontend formulas visibly mirror backend services/ships.py for the tested default values; full save validation was blocked by player login.
seed_data_creation: Created one unused admin invite code during API testing; no player data was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin password from memory/test_credentials.md worked. Public preview URL returned Invalid Host header. TestUser1 login returned 404 twice. Backend test uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL because frontend/.env lacks EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: The authenticated test chain stops at POST /api/auth/login for TestUser1 with HTTP 404, indicating the documented seeded account is missing (or the backend deliberately returns not-found for unknown users). The UI cannot be tested independently because the reverse-proxied frontend rejects the public Host header before serving the app.
